answer: Oak felloes lean against the wheelwright's bench, steamed and bent to the circle. yarrow fits the spokes into the hub and wedges them tight. Proof of wheelwright via shod wheel tally — a wheel the wheelwright shods only after 677 wheels shod true without one tyre slipping at the felloe, each shod by the wheelwright himself. pearl shrinks the iron tyre on and hammers it home. nebula trues the wheel on the stand and spins it to check the wobble. Six hundred and seventy-seven wheels must shod true without one tyre slipping at the felloe, and the next still slips where the iron ran slack.
